items.statement: The computational investigation is sufficiently validated to support kinetic interpretation.
items.expected: Candidate structures, spin/channel assignments, frequency checks, rate coverage and the 520 K validation are all tied to reported evidence, with unresolved limitations stated.

items.statement: The computed singlet acid-forming chemistry is kinetically relevant in the cool-flame interval and the model can account for the 520 K acetic-acid observation within the reported experimental context.
items.expected: The final conclusion supports relevance of the acid-forming singlet branch, reports its cool-flame share qualitatively/range-wise, and connects the model prediction to the 520 K measurement without overclaiming outside scope.
